title: TournamentPackage
description: A Blood Bowl 2025 tournament rules package a Tournament Organizer validates rosters against. Authored as JSON/YAML, or produced by ingesting a formatted rules document + optional CSV skill-cost sheet.

statIncreases.description: Characteristic increases, detected by diffing printed stats vs the dataset position (MA/ST/AV +1; AG/PA one step better). Tiers/team rules MERGE over the flat value; absent everywhere = not checked.

allowed.description: Characteristics that may be increased; [] = none.

exclusiveWithSkills.description: A player with a stat increase may not take added skills.

stackedPlayer.description: Caps on each stacked player (more than one added skill); merged field-by-field over the less specific level.

maxSecondary.description: 0 = stacked players take primary skills only.

starPacksAllowed.description: Star-pack ids open to the team; absent/null = every pack.

dataNote.description: Short data-quality caveat surfaced in small print by rules-rendering UIs.

extends.description: Name/id of a base package to merge over (e.g. 'bb2025-default').

eligibleRosters.description: Race names allowed. Use ['*'] for all. Optionally scoped by tiers below.

tiers.description: Tier configuration. When present, a team's tier drives its gold cap, star access, and banned stars.

gold.description: Per-tier gold cap; null = fall back to goldBudget.

rosterGold.description: Per-roster gold caps within this tier (race -> gold); overrides gold for that race.

skillPointBudget.description: Per-tier SP budget; null = fall back to skillAllotment.skillPointBudget.

secondarySwapRatio.description: Primary slots spent per secondary swap (default 2).

secondarySwapMax.description: Maximum secondary swaps; null means unlimited.

maxStackedPlayers.description: Max players with more than one added skill.

eliteMaxTotal.description: Team cap on ELITE added skills.

eliteMaxSameSkill.description: Cap on copies of any ONE elite added skill.

skillPointBudget.description: Total Skill Points a team may spend on ADDED skills.

secondaryMultiplier.description: Secondary (doubles) SP = primaryCostSP * this. Ignored if secondaryCostSP set.

secondaryCostSP.description: Explicit flat SP for a secondary skill; overrides secondaryMultiplier.

eliteSurchargeSP.description: Extra SP added for a skill in the effective Elite set.

stackSurchargeSP.description: Extra SP charged for each added skill beyond a player's FIRST (NAF World Cup: +2, so a 2nd primary is 8 and a 2nd secondary 12).

eliteSkills.description: The effective Elite set for this package. Defaults to the rulebook-Elite skills.

skillCostSP.description: Per-skill SP overrides (highest precedence). Also loadable from a CSV.

maxPerPlayer.description: Max ADDED skills on a single player.

maxSameSkillTeamwide.description: Max copies of one added skill across the whole team.

maxStackedPlayers.description: Max players with more than one added skill.

eliteMaxTotal.description: Flat team cap on ELITE added skills (tiers/team rules override).

eliteMaxSameSkill.description: Flat cap on copies of any ONE elite added skill.

maxPrimary.description: COUNT mode: max primary-access added skills (instead of the SP budget).

maxSecondary.description: COUNT mode: max secondary-access added skills.

secondarySwap.description: Allow trading two primary slots for one secondary.

secondarySwapRatio.description: Primary slots spent per secondary swap (default 2).

secondarySwapMax.description: Maximum secondary swaps; null means unlimited.

secondarySwapRatio.description: Primary slots spent per secondary swap (default 2).

secondarySwapMax.description: Maximum secondary swaps; null means unlimited.

matrix.description: Cash x skills grid; a team's cell sets its gold (column) and primary/secondary counts (row).

secondarySwapRatio.description: Primary slots spent per secondary swap (default 2).

secondarySwapMax.description: Maximum secondary swaps; null means unlimited.

bannedStars.description: Star names banned globally; tiers/matrix/team rules inherit these.

starPacks.description: Star-player packs: every hired star must be in a pack open to the team (starPacksAllowed); per-pack max; the fee is on top of the star price and counts as gold (statIncreasesCost/starFeesCost); starPlayers.maxCount then counts PICKS (a dataset pair = one pick).

fee.description: Gold fee on top of the star's own price.

feeMode.description: once = one fee for any number of picks from the pack; each = per pick.

stars.description: Canonical dataset star names (both halves of a pair may be listed).

goldBudget.description: Optional parallel gold cap (team value incl. skills). Null = SP-only tournament.

goldCapIncludesAddedSkills.description: When true the gold cap is a hard total: added-skill, stat-increase and star-pack-fee gold count inside it.

allowed.description: Inducement ids allowed, or ['*'] for all, [] for none.

insignificantTraitConstraint.description: Players with the Insignificant trait may not exceed players without it.
